observations: Photo 0: A used automatic transmission/gearbox assembly, bellhousing facing camera with torque converter visible, sitting on ground at a parts yard. Surrounded by other used engines and parts on shelves. A man in a green shirt is seated in background. White barcode/parts tag stuck on casing. A cable marked '1/2 IN SAE J1532' runs across top.

Photo 1: Closer view of the same transmission, showing torque converter face with orange paint mark, bolt holes, and dirty/oily casing. Another person in dark clothing stands behind. Wiring harness and connector visible below.

Photo 2: Another angle of the same transmission unit, showing full bellhousing, torque converter, and attached wiring harness and black plastic cover (solenoid/valve body cover) at bottom. More used engines and parts stacked in background, one wrapped in plastic.
